description:
From the fz-kdt.127 cold review (2026-09-02, F1). The proposal's admission
relation "same target AND captures overlap pointwise" is unsound for a
construction whose capture TYPE is a union (a wrapper over `int | float`
overlaps arm closure[L](int): the value reaches a body whose capture lane
is RawInt while the wrapper stored ValueRef). Admission must be
CONTAINMENT of the value's construction shape inside the arm's shape (the
lattice's closure-literal subtyping, emptiness.rs:177-217); only arm TESTS
relate by overlap / erasing-overlap, as TupleShapes. fz-kdt.127 stage (B)
builds containment; this ticket owns the red-first fixture that DISTINGUISHES
the two (not in the corpus): a closure minted at one site with a
union-typed capture (e.g. `c = if <runtime>, do: 1, else: 0.5; mk(c)`),
forwarded to a consumer specialized per capture type. Expected: correct
on all doors under containment; wrong/abort under overlap. Also pin the
interp/native agreement.

comments.text:
The red-first fixture this ticket asks for SHIPS IN fz-kdt.127.1, as
fixtures2/behavior/callable_union_capture_containment.fz (+ .oracle.exs,
.expected.txt). Written by the 127.1 adversarial refutation as probe
F_mailbox_union_capture and folded in on review.

It DISTINGUISHES the two relations, which is what was missing: a value
taken out of the mailbox is typed `any`, so `P.mk(a)` mints a construction
whose capture is a UNION and whose wrapper stores a BOXED word, beside the
`int` and `float` constructions of the same lambda; one forwarder `P.run/2`
carries all four.

MEASURED at 127.1's head (marker FIX3-1788383222 / REDOVERLAP-1788383233):

  containment (as landed)   interp 12 11.0 12 11.0
                            JIT    12 11.0 12 11.0
                            AOT    12 11.0 12 11.0   = Elixir oracle

  CallableShapes::enumerates swapped to shape.overlaps(ours)
                            interp 12.0 11.0 12 11.0  WRONG
                            JIT    abort, fz_closure_get_capture_f64
                                   expected float, got Int(1)

So containment-not-overlap is now gated by a corpus fixture on all three
doors, not by the single unit test
`a_union_capture_construction_is_admitted_only_by_a_test_that_contains_it`.
The interp/native agreement pin this ticket also asks for is covered by the
three-door lanes of that fixture.

NOT CLOSING -- the coordinator decides whether this ticket collapses into
127.1 or keeps its remaining scope.

FOLDED INTO fz-kdt.127.1 (2026-09-02, 8c3d5ce90): its witness ships as fixtures2/behavior/callable_union_capture_containment.fz (12 / 11.0 / 12 / 11.0 on all three doors; under an overlap swap of CallableShapes::enumerates the interp prints 12.0 and JIT aborts in fz_closure_get_capture_f64 -- proven red-first by the fold). Nothing remains for this ticket; closed as collapsed into 127.1.

title: A construction whose capture type is a union must be admitted by CONTAINMENT, never overlap: red-first fixture wanted
